light:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final square desktop application icon and emblem for the game ABANDONED, light appearance.
Primary request: Design one original, polished icon for a co-op salvage horror game where abandoned buildings collapse under the weight of loot. A powerful architectural capital A constructed from two broad concrete/steel structural legs and a broken floor crossbar. A single angular fracture cuts through the structure, with a small piece of the crossbar displaced downward to suggest imminent collapse. The negative-space doorway inside the A carries the eerie darkness of an abandoned building. The silhouette must read instantly at 32 pixels.
Style/medium: precision graphic logo, vector-friendly hard-edged silhouette, restrained tactile weathering, professional game branding; modern and ominous, industrial rather than cartoon.
Composition/framing: square 1024 by 1024 artwork, centered emblem occupying about 68% of canvas, generous clear space, front-facing orthographic, broad simple shapes. Rounded square pale warm concrete tile with a subtle beveled perimeter, all four corners fully visible, tile occupies 88% of canvas, genuinely transparent outside the tile. This tile shape is part of the light icon asset.
Color palette: light-mode icon; pale ivory/concrete tile, deep charcoal emblem, one restrained hazard amber/yellow exposed fracture edge consistent with ABANDONED's existing industrial yellow identity. Very high contrast.
Constraints: one icon only; no letters or words besides the abstract structural A; no caption, no slogan, no watermark; no presentation board, no multiple alternatives, no extra surrounding objects, no literal house roof, no skull, no unrelated tools. Keep the design simple and bold, with just enough damage to communicate collapse. Export actual transparency beyond the rounded-square tile.
